2610.07086.title: SchemaFill: Efficient LLM Tool Calling via Slot-Parallel Speculative Decoding
2610.07086.paper_summary: LLM agents interact with external systems by generating structured tool calls. Given a user request, conversational context, and a catalog of tool schemas, a tool-calling model must select tools and generate their arguments, potentially producing multiple calls in a single response. Standard autoregressive decoding generates these calls token by token, incurring substantial latency for requests involving multiple calls or many argument fields. The explicit argument structure offers opportunities for parallel generation, but later argument values may depend on preceding fields and calls, so independently generated values can differ from the target model's output. We present SchemaFill, a framework for efficient LLM tool calling through slot-parallel speculative decoding. SchemaFill generates future slot values concurrently as candidates, without requiring advance knowledge of the actual call sequence or argument values. Candidates spanning multiple fields and calls are concatenated for verification by the target model under the actual output prefix. Only verified tokens are committed, and the target supplies corrections when candidates disagree. This applies target verification while exploiting parallelism across slots and calls. On Glaive and BFCL, SchemaFill achieves up to a 4.05$\times$ improvement in end-to-end throughput over autoregressive decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill.
2610.07086.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理透過生成結構化的工具調用與外部系統互動。根據用戶請求、對話上下文和工具架構目錄，工具調用模型必須選擇工具並生成其參數，可能在單一響應中產生多個調用。標準自回歸解碼以逐個標記的方式生成這些調用，對於涉及多個調用或許多參數字段的請求，會產生相當大的延遲。明確的參數結構提供了並行生成的機會，但後續的參數值可能依賴於前面的字段和調用，因此獨立生成的值可能與目標模型的輸出不同。我們提出了 SchemaFill，一個通過槽並行推測解碼來高效調用 LLM 工具的框架。SchemaFill 同時生成未來槽值作為候選者，而無需提前了解實際的調用序列或參數值。跨越多個字段和調用的候選者會被串聯起來，供目標模型在實際輸出前綴下進行驗證。只有經過驗證的標記才會被提交，當候選者不一致時，目標會提供修正。這在利用槽和調用之間的並行性時應用目標驗證。在 Glaive 和 BFCL 上，SchemaFill 在端到端吞吐量上比自回歸解碼提高了多達 4.05$\times$ 的性能。代碼可在 https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill 獲得。
